restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes: one root chunk block, flags 11 (CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT), block length 64, counter 0, one prefix round.

Deterministic straight-line construction: 235 charged word operations = 203 data-path operations + 32 output stores (one store per 32-bit message word); no randomness, no trials, no branches, no compression evaluation, no collision check, no restart.

All intermediates are register-resident under the declared allocation (144 allocated registers, at most 34 live simultaneously in the emitted order, no spill traffic, no intermediate loads or stores); the register file and code are charged in memory.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 1 prefix round; the pair is produced by closed-form solving of the eight G functions of the single compression.
Narrow arithmetic follows scripts/reference_operation_costs.py norms: masked add/sub = 2 ops, xor/or/and/shift = 1 op, 32-bit rotation = 4 ops (shl, shr, or, and); no native rotate.
Instruction-stream constants are immediate operands (program text, charged in memory, not re-read as data); the algorithm itself performs no data-table lookup.

proof.md Section 7 discloses the totals and stated bounds under alternative readings: data-path only (0.914 units, below one compression), constant loads on a no-immediates machine, packed 256-bit stores, table preprocessing over-charge, and a self-check variant.
success_probability = 1: the pair identity is a proved algebraic identity evaluated for the fixed disclosed constants; the attached certificate lets the organizer verifier recompute both digests.
No precomputed collision, no experiment, no heuristic is used or claimed; heuristics is empty.
